title: Virtual Reality Use for ICU Mobility
official: Designing a Virtual Reality Intervention to Improve Physical and Psychological Health in Intensive Care Units
summary: The purpose of this study is to explore if Virtual Reality (VR) helps patients in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) move more and feel better.

interventions.name: Nurse driven virtual reality mobility session

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* English speaking
* Adults age 18 or greater
* ICU stay greater or equal to 3 days
* Limited mobility

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Special enteric contact isolation
* Blindness
* History of seizure or vertigo
* Intubated and sedated
* ICU delirium
